description: The router's DNS resolver, Unbound: the addresses it answers on, whom it answers, where it sends queries, and its DNS64 and local zones.

allow.description: Address ranges of the clients the resolver answers; it refuses others, and the firewall accepts DNS from these alone. A family's whole range, `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`, answers whoever reaches the addresses of `listen`: an open resolver, if one of them faces the internet.

x-chalkos-rules.description: The resolver's clients are address ranges.
x-chalkos-rules.message: a client is no address range

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the range " + self.filter(a, size(self.filter(b, cidr(b) == cidr(a))) > 1)[0] + " appears more than once"

prefix.description: NAT64 prefix the resolver synthesizes AAAA records in, from the A records of names that have no AAAA record.

dns64.description: DNS64: AAAA records the resolver synthesizes for IPv4-only names, and its answer for `ipv4only.arpa`; null synthesizes none.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A NAT64 prefix is an IPv6 range of 32, 40, 48, 56, 64 or 96 bits of no link-local, multicast or unspecified addresses, whose bits 64 to 71 are zero, as RFC 6052 gives them.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: !(cidr(self.prefix).ip(0).family() == "ipv6" && cidr(self.prefix).prefix() in [32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 96] && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(cidr(self.prefix).ip(0))) ? "the prefix " + self.prefix + " is no NAT64 prefix; give an IPv6 range of 32, 40, 48, 56, 64 or 96 bits, such as 64:ff9b::/96" : !cel.bind(x, cidr(self.prefix).ip(0), x != ip("::") && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x)) ? "the prefix " + self.prefix + " holds link-local, multicast or unspecified addresses" : "the prefix " + self.prefix + " sets bits 64 to 71, which RFC 6052 keeps zero"
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self == null || (cidr(self.prefix).ip(0).family() == "ipv6" && cidr(self.prefix).prefix() in [32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 96] && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(cidr(self.prefix).ip(0)) && cel.bind(x, cidr(self.prefix).ip(0), x != ip("::") && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x)) && cel.bind(a, string(cidr(self.prefix).ip(0)), cidr(a + "/72").ip(0) == cidr(a + "/64").ip(0)))

dnssec.description: Whether the resolver validates DNSSEC with the root's trust anchor of the image. The forwarders then pass DNSSEC records on.

forwarders.description: Resolvers the router sends its queries to; empty resolves names itself, from the root servers.

x-chalkos-rules.description: The resolver forwards to unicast addresses.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the forwarder " + self.filter(a, !cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))[0] + " is no unicast address"
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(a, cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the forwarder " + self.filter(a, size(self.filter(b, ip(b) == ip(a))) > 1)[0] + " appears more than once"

listen.description: Addresses of the router on which the resolver answers on port 53, over UDP and TCP; the firewall accepts DNS on them from `allow`.

x-chalkos-rules.description: The resolver listens on unicast addresses.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the address " + self.filter(a, !cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))[0] + " is no unicast address the resolver can listen on"
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(a, cel.bind(x, ip(a), x != ip("0.0.0.0") && x != ip("::") && !cidr("127.0.0.0/8").contains(x) && x != ip("::1") && !cidr("169.254.0.0/16").contains(x) && !cidr("fe80::/10").contains(x) && !cidr("224.0.0.0/4").contains(x) && !cidr("ff00::/8").contains(x) && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)))

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the address " + self.filter(a, size(self.filter(b, ip(b) == ip(a))) > 1)[0] + " appears more than once"

localZones.description: Zones the resolver answers from its own records, 150 records in all at most. With `dns64`, no zone holds `ipv4only.arpa`, which DNS64 answers.

name.description: Name of the zone, in lower case and without the root's dot.

records.description: Records the router answers for names of the zone.

name.description: Name of the record: the zone's name or a name below it.

ttl.description: Seconds a resolver may keep the record.

value.description: Data of the record, of up to 255 printable ASCII characters other than quotes and backslashes: an address for `A` and `AAAA`, a name for `CNAME` and `PTR`, `<preference> <name>` for `MX`, `<priority> <weight> <port> <name>` for `SRV`, and text for `TXT`.

type.description: How Unbound answers names of the zone, as its `local-zone` types say: `static` answers from the records alone, `transparent` resolves the names the records lack, `typetransparent` also the types they lack, `redirect` answers every name below the zone with the zone's own records, `refuse` and `deny` refuse or drop the queries the records do not answer, and `always_nxdomain` answers that no name exists.

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the local zone " + self.filter(z, size(self.filter(y, y.name == z.name)) > 1)[0].name + " appears more than once"

x-chalkos-rules.description: A local zone's records are of the zone's name or names below it.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(z, self.filter(z, !z.records.all(r, r.name == z.name || r.name.endsWith("." + z.name)))[0], "the local zone " + z.name + " holds a record of " + z.records.filter(r, !(r.name == z.name || r.name.endsWith("." + z.name)))[0].name + ", which is outside it")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(z, z.records.all(r, r.name == z.name || r.name.endsWith("." + z.name)))

x-chalkos-rules.description: The names of local zones and their records hold 253 characters at most.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the name " + (self.map(z, z.name) + self.map(z, z.records).flatten().map(r, r.name)).filter(n, size(n) > 253)[0] + " holds more than 253 characters"

x-chalkos-rules.description: An A or AAAA record holds an address of its family.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(r, self.map(z, z.records).flatten().filter(r, !(r.type == "A" ? ip(r.value).family() == "ipv4" : r.type != "AAAA" || cel.bind(x, ip(r.value), x.family() == "ipv6" && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)) && !r.value.contains("%")))[0], "the " + r.type + " record of " + r.name + " holds " + r.value + ", which is no " + (r.type == "A" ? "IPv4" : "IPv6") + " address")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.map(z, z.records).flatten().all(r, (r.type == "A" ? ip(r.value).family() == "ipv4" : r.type != "AAAA" || cel.bind(x, ip(r.value), x.family() == "ipv6" && !cidr("::ffff:0:0/96").contains(x)) && !r.value.contains("%")))

x-chalkos-rules.description: The local zones hold 150 records at most, which the rules can compare in pairs.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the local zones hold " + string(size(self.map(z, z.records).flatten())) + " records, more than the 150 whose duplicates chalkd can check"

x-chalkos-rules.description: A record appears once, as Unbound keeps one of its copies.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(e, self.map(z, z.records).flatten(), size(e) > 50 ? "a record appears more than once in the local zones, with one name, type and value; Unbound keeps one" : cel.bind(r, e.filter(x, size(e.filter(y, x.name == y.name && x.type == y.type && (x.type == "AAAA" ? ip(x.value) == ip(y.value) : x.value == y.value))) > 1)[0], "the record " + r.name + " " + r.type + " " + (r.type == "AAAA" ? string(ip(r.value)) : r.value) + " appears more than once; Unbound keeps one"))
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(e, self.map(z, z.records).flatten(), size(e) > 150 || e.all(x, size(e.filter(y, x.name == y.name && x.type == y.type && (x.type == "AAAA" ? ip(x.value) == ip(y.value) : x.value == y.value))) == 1))

x-chalkos-rules.description: A redirect zone's records are of the zone's name, which Unbound answers for every name below it.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(z, self.filter(z, z.type == "redirect" && !z.records.all(r, r.name == z.name))[0], "the redirect zone " + z.name + " holds a record of " + z.records.filter(r, r.name != z.name)[0].name + "; a redirect zone's records are of its own name, which Unbound answers for every name below it")

x-chalkos-rules.description: A CNAME record's name holds no other record.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(e, self.map(z, z.records).flatten(), e.filter(x, x.type == "CNAME" && size(e.filter(y, y.name == x.name)) > 1)[0].name + " holds a CNAME record and another record; a CNAME's name holds it alone")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(e, self.map(z, z.records).flatten(), size(e) > 150 || e.all(x, x.type != "CNAME" || size(e.filter(y, y.name == x.name)) == 1))

title: Resolver

rules.description: A Resolver listens on an address of a family its clients' ranges are of.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, !["ipv4", "ipv6"].exists(f, s.listen.exists(a, ip(a).family() == f) && s.allow.exists(p, cidr(p).ip(0).family() == f)))).map(n, "Resolver " + n).join(", ") + " listens on no address of a family its clients' ranges are of, so it would answer no one; give listen and allow a family in common"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, ["ipv4", "ipv6"].exists(f, s.listen.exists(a, ip(a).family() == f) && s.allow.exists(p, cidr(p).ip(0).family() == f))))

rules.description: With DNS64, no local zone holds ipv4only.arpa, which Unbound would answer before DNS64.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.dns64 != null && s.localZones.exists(z, (z.name == "ipv4only.arpa" || z.name.endsWith(".ipv4only.arpa") || "ipv4only.arpa".endsWith("." + z.name))))).map(n, "Resolver " + n).join(", ") + " has a local zone over ipv4only.arpa, which Unbound would answer before DNS64; drop the zone or DNS64"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.dns64 == null || !s.localZones.exists(z, (z.name == "ipv4only.arpa" || z.name.endsWith(".ipv4only.arpa") || "ipv4only.arpa".endsWith("." + z.name)))))
